description: This file defines the 'Worker' class, which manages web and service workers in the Playwright automation framework. It includes methods for evaluating scripts within workers, handling events like 'close', and interacting with associated page or context objects.

classes.name: Worker
classes.description: Represents a web or service worker, capable of evaluating scripts and handling events within the worker context.

methods.name: fromNullable
methods.description: Creates a Worker instance from a nullable channel object, returning null if input is undefined.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a Worker instance from a WorkerChannel object.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a Worker instance, sets up event subscriptions and handles cleanup on close.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the worker.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a function or script within the worker context and returns the result.

methods.name: evaluateHandle
methods.description: Evaluates a function or script within the worker context and returns a handle to the result.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specific event to occur within the worker, with optional predicate and timeout.
